integrity: The proof is self-contained with a standard fundamental-matrix identity; exact rational checks are supplementary and not formal or independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Finite irreducible loop-free semi-Markov networks; entry-epoch first/second hitting moments only. An implicit equivalent in older general moment-recursion literature remains a residual originality risk.
title: Second-moment Markov mimicry in finite semi-Markov networks is exactly locally identifiable
